title: Cross Product and Its Applications
topicTitle: Cross product (vector product) and its applications
notes: **Definition:** $\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\sin\theta \, \hat{n}$, where $\hat{n}$ is perpendicular to both $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$, given by right-hand rule.
**Magnitude:** $|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|$ equals the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$.
**Zero condition:** $\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \vec{0}$ if $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ are parallel or antiparallel ($\theta = 0$ or $\pi$).
